answer: Make every agent post a non-refundable stake burned at enrollment, so standing up a grove of sybil identities costs real capital per node instead of nothing. Weight trust by that bond and let reputation ripple only along edges backed by escrowed collateral, never by raw headcount. Tag each identity with the umber trail of its funding wallet slashing history, so one caught fraud burns the whole cluster, making mass forgery cost far more than the influence it can ever buy.
